text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Cesario hadn't changed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Showing up for training with a composed expression and doing what needed to be done for the Shuka Sho.
Days like that continued on.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
My legs are in good shape today.
Regarding the training regimen—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There are two options.
Upper body strength training, or long-distance swimming.
Which shall it be, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Strength training it is, then.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We will begin with the same workload level as last time—
if there are no issues, we will increase the load further.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I'll start stretching now, so Trainer, please prepare the equipment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She works through her training with quiet determination.
Her focus is steady, and her skills are clearly improving.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa!
Haa... ngh!
choice_data_list: Hang in there, just a little further!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, yes!
I can still keep going...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Understood. Long-distance swimming it is.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The distance achievable under my current condition—
plus a little extra load would be ideal, I suppose."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I will go get changed,
so please begin once the target location has been decided.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She works through her training with quiet determination.
Her focus is steady, and her skills are clearly improving.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*, *wheeze*! *cough*!
...Way further away than I thought... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There are no issues...
It served as good training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...
Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
――?
Yes, there's no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even in situations where she used to be mostly in 'off' mode, she increasingly remained in 'on' mode.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I wanted to avoid urging her to take a break if at all possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she ran toward the Shuka Sho,
she wanted to wait for the next light to naturally reveal itself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, I can't wait any longer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant*!
*pant, pant*!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (...Lately, my body feels so heavy...!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...!
Haaaaaaahhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: *Pant*, *gasp*, *pant*, *pant*...
choice_data_list: Good work. Once you've rested, I wanted to talk—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me,
please let me do a few more reps.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'd rather avoid training
that puts too much heavy strain on me all at once.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Many talented Umamusume
await you at the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: What needs to be done even after the Shuka Sho is—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah. No, um—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: After the Shuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Wondering which race she should enter...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow... it feels like grasping at thin air...
Where am I... going—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon me.
I am truly sorry."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Just how much radiance
she found in that place.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Challenging the "Oaks" across three nations—Japan, the US, and Europe—
that is truly where Cesario shines brightest,
and right now—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, my heart... is trembling so fiercely!
Trainer...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I was always by your side,
I understand all too painfully well.
choice_data_list: …You wanted to race in America, didn't you?
...You wanted to run in America, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The blue turf of California.
A high sky and dazzling sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And there—a battle against the world's greatest rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her explosive power bursts forth on that stage.
Pulling away from the other Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A commanding victory by 3, no, 4 lengths!

text_block_list.name: Commentator (Male)
text_block_list.text: Japanese superstar Cesario!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Even though a scenery like that could have existed..."
choice_data_list: ...I am truly frustrated from the bottom of my heart.
...From the bottom of my heart, it's frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Is there anything ahead that can surpass that brilliance?
How should I seek the light in the Senior Class—"
choice_data_list: To be honest, I don't even want to think about what's next yet.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I... also...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Regardless, I knew I had to keep moving forward...
Otherwise, I would never...
never reach the future I wished for... That's what I thought—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Still... the truth is...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Moving forward... is just so scary...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The sheer scale of what I once dreamed of—
its brilliance is...gah!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Because the further I go... the more... ngh,
I'll understand...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...U-Ah...!
Uwaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry!
T-This is troubling for you, isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even if I cry... gh,
it won't change... a thing... and yet!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Still, the... tears won't... stop... ngh,
I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I lend my shoulder to her as she struggles.
Tears quickly spill over and stain my clothes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To lose something—and yet move forward.
What was needed was surely not a new light.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff*...
...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Crying too much gives you a headache, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thank you very much.
My mind feels... somewhat cleared up now, too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
......
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to say one thing,
just to put an end to this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario looked straight at me.
Her tightly set lips opened as if she had made up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I gave up on the American Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her brief words trembled.
It was a dignified yet sorrowful whisper,
as if bidding farewell to someone precious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the brilliance of the explosively born dream was lost,
the path to the future still continues.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From now on, we will accomplish what must be done on this path.
That was the pledge they made to each other.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Good morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the following morning.
The Cesario who showed up for training
was the very same Cesario from before.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I'm sorry to have worried you... But I'm all right now, so let's make this a great journey together!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: So, um...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
After that, while I was in bed,
I came to an incredible realization.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I realized that... no matter how pathetic I am,
you'll always be there to help me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I swore to share my destiny with you.
Though it's not quite 'in sickness and in health'—
I won't easily give up on you."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“...I see.
It's only natural, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The smile I saw on Cesario's face after so long was none other than the innocent smile of a young girl."
